verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a dedicated 'Ironclad AI' product page marketed as 'A New Era of Contract Intelligence,' implying AI-driven insights over contract data, but the evidence pack contains only page titles/taglines with no detail on what specific insights, suggestions, or analytics are actually generated or how a user interacts with them. Missing for 10: concrete feature descriptions (e.g., risk analysis, clause suggestions, obligation extraction), first-party documentation of AI capabilities, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI features working as described.
